titleEn: The Glory of Kings — The Nobles' Sons Sent with David (ch. 43)
part: ch. 43 — The Nobles' Sons Sent with David
about: Menelik, crowned as David king of Ethiopia, is to be attended by the firstborn sons of Israel's nobles, who take their fathers' offices; the officers are named and Solomon's gifts are given. The parents weep and curse the king in secret, then flatter him to his face; the chapter closes on the king's patience and the doctrine that God's spirit rests in the king's heart.

sentences.t: ፵፫ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ተአዘዙ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ ኀይለ ፡ እስራኤል ።
sentences.l: 43. Where were-commanded sons-of strength-of Israel.
sentences.i: Chapter 43: How the sons of the host of Israel were commanded.
sentences.n: Chapter heading. ደቂቀ is the construct of ደቂቅ 'sons, children': 'sons-of'; ኀይለ is the construct form of ኀይል 'strength, force, host', the second link of the chain ደቂቀ ኀይለ እስራኤል: 'sons of the strength-of Israel' (ኀይል also means 'army', hence 'host' in i). ተአዘዙ is 3mp perfect of the passive-reflexive stem of አዘዘ 'command' (the T stem can also mean 'obey' (?)). The opening ኀበ is the heading formula of chapters 23, 24, 36 and 40; l keeps 'Where', i smooths it to 'How', as those parts do; the chapter tells of the nobles' sons commanded to go with David to Ethiopia.

sentences.t: ሀገርሰ ፡ ተፈሥሐት ፡ በእንተ ፡ ዘአንገሠ ፡ ወልዶ ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ ወረሰዮ ፡ ንጉሠ ፡ እምደወሉ ፡ እስከ ፡ ደወለ ፡ ባዕድ ፤
sentences.l: Land-indeed rejoiced concerning that-he-made-king his-son king, and-made-him king from-its-border to border-of another;
sentences.i: The land, for its part, rejoiced because he had made his son king, and had set him as king from its own border to the border of another land;
sentences.n: ሀገርሰ is ሀገር 'city, land' + the particle -ሰ 'indeed, for its part', which sets this clause against the next. ተፈሥሐት is 3fs perfect (ሀገር is feminine). በእንተ ዘ- 'on account of that which', hence 'because'; ዘአንገሠ is አንገሠ, the causative of ነግሠ 'reign': 'he made king'. ወልዶ is ወልድ + -ሁ 'his', contracted; ንጉሥ the second object, 'king'. ወረሰዮ is ወ- + ረሰየ 'set, make' + -ዮ 'him'; ንጉሠ is the predicate accusative, 'as king'. እምደወሉ 'from his/its border' and ደወለ ባዕድ 'the border of another' (construct + ባዕድ 'other, foreign'). ደወል 'border' is a doubtful word to me (?): the sense 'from his own frontier to a foreign frontier' fits, and the lexicon is not at hand.

sentences.t: ወዓዲ ፡ ሐዘነት ፡ ሀገር ፡ እስመ ፡ አዘዘ ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ ከመ ፡ የሀቡ ፡ ደቂቆሙ ፡ እለ ፡ ተሰምዩ ፡ በኵረ ፤
sentences.l: And-also grieved land, for commanded king that they-give their-sons who were-called firstborn;
sentences.i: And the land grieved too, for the king commanded that they give their sons, those who were called firstborn;
sentences.n: ሐዘነት is read as a verb, 3fs perfect of ሐዘነ 'grieve', parallel to ተፈሥሐት 'rejoiced' before it (it could instead be the noun ሐዘን 'grief' with an ending (?)). እስመ 'for, because'. ከመ + subjunctive: የሀቡ is the 3mp subjunctive of ወሀበ 'give'; ደቂቆሙ 'their sons' (-ሙ 'their'). እለ ተሰምዩ 'who were called' (passive of ሰምየ 'name'); በኵረ is accusative, 'as firstborn'. The decree is that the nobles give their firstborn sons to go with the new king.

sentences.t: ወእለኒ ፡ እምየማን ፡ ከማሁ ፡ ይንበሩ ፡ በከመ ፡ አበዊሆሙ ፡ ይነብሩ ፡ ምስለ ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ ሰሎሞን ፡ ከማሁ ፡ ይንበሩ ፡ በየማነ ፡ ወልዱ ፡ ዳዊት ፡ ንጉሠ ፡ ኢትዮጵያ ፡ ወእለኒ ፡ እምፀጋም ፡ ከማሁ ፡ ይንበሩ ፡ በከመ ፡ አበዊሆሙ ፡ ይነብሩ ፡ ምስለ ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ ሰሎሞን ፡ ከማሁ ፡ ይንበሩ ፡ በፀጋሙ ፡ ለወልዱ ፡ ዳዊት ፡ ንጉሠ ፡ ኢትዮጵያ ፤
sentences.l: And-those-also from-right likewise let-them-sit as their-fathers sit with king Solomon, likewise let-them-sit at-right-of his-son David king-of Ethiopia; and-those-also from-left likewise let-them-sit as their-fathers sit with king Solomon, likewise let-them-sit at-his-left to-his-son David king-of Ethiopia;
sentences.i: And those of the right hand, likewise let them sit, as their fathers sit with King Solomon: likewise let them sit at the right of his son David, king of Ethiopia. And those of the left hand, likewise let them sit, as their fathers sit with King Solomon: likewise let them sit at the left of his son David, king of Ethiopia;
sentences.n: The court is arranged in two ranks, right hand (የማን) and left hand (ፀጋም), the sons taking the places their fathers hold beside Solomon. ወእለኒ is ወ- + እለ 'those who' + the enclitic -ኒ 'also'. ይንበሩ is the 3mp subjunctive (here a jussive, 'let them sit') and ይነብሩ the 3mp imperfect, 'they sit'; ነበረ means both 'dwell' and 'sit'. በከመ 'in the way that, as'. በየማነ 'at the right of' (construct). Note በፀጋሙ ለወልዱ, literally 'at his left, of his son': a suffix anticipates a possessor that is then named with ለ-, a pattern that will return (ልቡ ለንጉሥ in the last unit). 'David, king of Ethiopia' is the throne-name of Solomon's son (Menelik), as the book has told it.

sentences.t: ወሢመቶሙኒ ፡ በከመ ፡ አበዊሆሙ ፡ ወአስማቲሆሙኒ ፡ በከመ ፡ አበዊሆሙ ፤ ፤
sentences.l: And-their-offices-also as their-fathers, and-their-names-also as their-fathers; ;
sentences.i: And their offices also as their fathers' were, and their titles also as their fathers' were; ;
sentences.n: ሢመት 'appointment, office' (ሢመቶሙ 'their offices') and ስም 'name' (አስማቲሆሙ, the plural with -ሆሙ 'their'), each with the enclitic -ኒ 'also'. Here 'names' is best read as 'titles'. No verb is written: 'their offices (are) as their fathers'. The source has a doubled ፤ ፤ here; it is kept attached to this unit.

sentences.t: ወኵሉ ፡ በከመ ፡ በበሥርዐቱ ፡ ወበበ ፡ በከመ ፡ ዕበዩ ፡ ወበበ ፡ በከመ ፡ ምልክናሁ ፡ ወበበ ፡ በከመ ፡ ምርካቡ ፡ ወበበ ፡ በከመ ፡ ምኵናኑ ፤
sentences.l: And-all according-to each-his-order, and-each according-to his-greatness, and-each according-to his-lordship (?), and-each according-to his-standing (?), and-each according-to his-authority (?);
sentences.i: And everyone according to his rank, each according to his greatness, each according to his lordship (?), each according to his standing (?), and each according to his authority (?);
sentences.n: A list of five measures, each with በከመ 'according to'. በበሥርዐቱ is the distributive በበ- 'each by each' + ሥርዐት 'order, rank' + -ሁ. In the following clauses በበ is written as a separate word before በከመ; this looks like a copying quirk or an elliptical 'and each (according to)'. ዕበዩ 'his greatness' (ዕበይ). ምልክና 'lordship, dominion' (from ምልክ; I cannot check the word (?)). ምርካቡ is from ረከበ 'find, obtain'; ch. 38–39 meets ምርካብ in the same setting (court rank carried to Ethiopia) and reads it 'rank, standing (?)', which this part follows: 'his standing (?)'. ምኵናን is from ኰነነ 'judge, rule': 'authority, jurisdiction' (?). The last three are uncertain without the lexicon.

sentences.t: ከማሁ ፡ ይኩኑ ፡ በከመ ፡ ገብረ ፡ ሰሎሞን ፡ ለመኳንንቲሁ ፡ ከማሁ ፡ ይግበር ፡ ሎሙ ፡ ዳዊትሂ ፡ ለመኳንንቲሁ ፡ ወበከመ ፡ ሠርዖሙ ፡ ሰሎሞን ፡ ለመገብቱ ፡ ወከማሁ ፡ ዳዊትሂ ፡ ይሥራዕ ፡ ሥርዐተ ፡ ቤቱ ፨
sentences.l: Likewise let-them-be according-as did Solomon for-his-nobles, likewise let-do for-them David-also for-his-nobles; and-according-as ordained-them Solomon for-his-stewards (?), and-likewise David-also let-him-ordain the-ordinance-of his-house.
sentences.i: Let them be just as Solomon did for his nobles; and likewise let David also do for them, for his own nobles. And as Solomon ordained them for his stewards (?), so also let David set in order the ordinance of his house.
sentences.n: ይኩኑ is the 3mp subjunctive of ኮነ 'be'; ገብረ 'did'; ይግበር 'let him do' (3ms jussive) with ሎሙ 'to them'. መኳንንት is the plural of መኰንን 'noble, governor' (ለመኳንንቲሁ 'for his nobles'). The enclitic -ሂ in ዳዊትሂ is 'also'. ሠርዖሙ is ሠርዐ 'ordain, set in order' + -ሙ 'them'; ይሥራዕ the jussive, and ሥርዐተ the construct 'ordinance-of' before ቤቱ 'his house'. ለመገብቱ is uncertain (?): taken, as in ch. 29 and 38–39, as the plural መገብት 'stewards' (from the root of መጋቢ below) + -ሁ 'his', with ለ- 'for'; 'his service' is the other possibility. The ፨ closing this unit marks the end of the general rule; the list of names follows. Solomon's court order is the model Menelik is to copy, the Jerusalem order carried over to the new Zion.

sentences.t: ወከመ ፡ ዝ ፡ አስማቲሆሙ ፡ ለእለ ፡ ተሠይሙ ፡ ይትፈነዉ ።
sentences.l: And-as this, their-names, of-those who were-appointed, to-be-sent.
sentences.i: And these are the names of those who were appointed to be sent.
sentences.n: ወከመ ዝ 'and as this', introducing the list. ተሠይሙ is the 3mp perfect of the passive (tä-stem) of ሠየመ 'appoint'; ይትፈነዉ the 3mp subjunctive of the passive of ፈነወ 'send', 'that they be sent'. The names that follow are almost all in the pattern ወ- + name + ወልደ 'son of' + father's name + office. ወልደ is the construct, 'son-of', so each office is in apposition to the son. Most of these men are not otherwise known to me, and the forms are given as Bezold has them.

sentences.t: አዛርያስ ፡ ወልደ ፡ ሳዶቅ ፡ ካህን ፡ ዝውእቱ ፡ ሊቀ ፡ ካህናት ፤
sentences.l: Azaryas son-of Zadok, priest, this-is chief-of priests;
sentences.i: Azariah son of Zadok, the priest, who is the high priest;
sentences.n: Azariah son of Zadok the priest is named among Solomon's officials in 1 Kings 4:2, which is the model here. ሊቀ ካህናት is 'chief-of priests' (ሊቅ 'chief, elder', construct ሊቀ; ካህናት the plural of ካህን), so 'high priest' by its parts. ዝውእቱ is ዝ + ውእቱ, 'this is he', an appositional 'that is'; the same word will recur.

sentences.t: ወኤልያስ ፡ ወልደ ፡ አርኒ ፡ ሊቀ ፡ ዲያቆናት ፡ ወአቡሁሰ ፡ ለአርኒ ፡ ሊቀ ፡ ዲያቆናት ፡ ናታን ፡ ነቢይ ፤
sentences.l: And-Elyas son-of Arni, chief-of deacons; and-his-father-indeed, of-Arni chief-of deacons, Nathan prophet;
sentences.i: And Elijah son of Arni, chief of deacons; and the father of Arni, chief of deacons, was Nathan the prophet;
sentences.n: ዲያቆናት is the plural of ዲያቆን (Greek diakonos), 'deacon', so ሊቀ ዲያቆናት 'chief-of deacons'. The second half is hard to parse: ወአቡሁሰ ለአርኒ is 'and as for his father, that of Arni' (አቡሁ + ሰ 'indeed', with the anticipatory ለ- naming the possessor), and I take ናታን ነቢይ as the predicate, so Arni's father is Nathan the prophet (the ሊቀ ዲያቆናት after Arni being a repeated title). It could also be read as Nathan being Elijah's father (?); the grammar favours Arni. Nathan the prophet is David's prophet in 2 Samuel 7 and 1 Kings 1.

sentences.t: ወአድራም ፡ ወልደ ፡ አርድሮንስ ፡ መልአከ ፡ አሕዛብ ፤
sentences.l: And-Adram son-of Ardrons, messenger-of peoples;
sentences.i: And Adram son of Ardrons, messenger of the peoples;
sentences.n: መልአክ is 'messenger' (also 'angel'); in an office list it is the head or envoy of a department, so መልአከ አሕዛብ is 'messenger-of peoples' (አሕዛብ, plural of ሕዝብ), perhaps an overseer of the foreign peoples or nations (?). The names Adram and Ardrons are unidentified.

sentences.t: ወፈንቄራ ፡ ወልደ ፡ ሶባ ፡ ጸሓፌ ፡ ላህም ፤
sentences.l: And-Fanqera son-of Soba, scribe-of cattle;
sentences.i: And Fanqera son of Soba, scribe of the cattle;
sentences.n: ጸሓፌ is the construct of ጸሓፊ 'scribe' (the ending -ኤ is the construct of nouns in -ኢ), so 'scribe-of'; ላህም is 'cow, cattle, herd'. A recorder over the royal herds (?).

sentences.t: ወአኮንሔል ፡ ወልደ ፡ ጦፌል ፡ እንዘ ፡ ሕፃን ፤
sentences.l: And-Akonhel son-of Tofel, while child;
sentences.i: And Akonhel son of Tofel, still a child;
sentences.n: እንዘ 'while' + a nominal predicate: 'while a child' (ሕፃን). A young man is named among the officers, which is to say that these were sons succeeding fathers.

sentences.t: ወሳምንያስ ፡ ወልደ ፡ አኪታለም ፡ መዘክር ፤
sentences.l: And-Samnyas son-of Akitalem, recorder;
sentences.i: And Samnyas son of Akitalem, recorder;
sentences.n: መዘክር 'one who recalls, remembrancer', from ዘከረ 'remember'; it matches the 'recorder' (Hebrew mazkir) of David's and Solomon's courts in 2 Samuel 8:16 and 1 Kings 4:3.

sentences.t: ወፈቃሮስ ፡ ወልደ ፡ ንያ ፡ መልአከ ፡ ሰርዌ ፡ ዝውእቱ ፡ ሊቀ ፡ ሐራ ፤
sentences.l: And-Faqaros son-of Nya, messenger-of host (?), this-is chief-of soldiers;
sentences.i: And Faqaros son of Nya, messenger of the host (?), who is the chief of the soldiers;
sentences.n: ሰርዌ I take as 'host, army' (cf. ሠራዊት), though I also know a ሰርዌ 'creeping thing, serpent', so the word is hedged (?), and ሐራ is 'soldiers'; ሊቀ ሐራ 'chief-of soldiers' is a commander. ዝውእቱ again glosses the first title by the second.

sentences.t: ወሌዋንዶስ ፡ ወልደ ፡ አኪሬ ፡ መልአከ ፡ አንገቦት ፤
sentences.l: And-Lewandos son-of Akire, messenger-of angebot (?);
sentences.i: And Lewandos son of Akire, messenger of the angebot (?);
sentences.n: አንገቦት is a word I cannot place (?). It looks like a plural in -ት; I leave it untranslated rather than guess a meaning.

sentences.t: ወፋቁጤን ፡ ወልደ ፡ አድራይ ፡ መልአካዊ ፡ ለባሕር ፤
sentences.l: And-Faqetin son-of Adray, messenger-ish for-sea;
sentences.i: And Faqetin son of Adray, the one over the sea (?);
sentences.n: መልአካዊ is built on መልአክ 'messenger' with the adjective ending -ዊ ('messenger-like, angelic'); ለባሕር 'of the sea'. The title seems to mean a commissioner or admiral of the sea (?), but the form is odd and I am not sure.

sentences.t: ወማታን ፡ ወልደ ፡ ብንያስ ፡ መልህቀ ፡ ቤት ፤
sentences.l: And-Matan son-of Bnyas, anchor-of house (?);
sentences.i: And Matan son of Bnyas, 'anchor of the house' (?);
sentences.n: መልህቅ is, as far as I recall, 'anchor'; as a title before ቤት 'house' it may be a figure ('the anchor of the house') or from a root meaning 'great' (?). Either way it is an office in the palace and uncertain.

sentences.t: ወአድዐረዝ ፡ ወልደ ፡ ኪሬም ፡ ደቀ ፡ ሰርጒ ፤
sentences.l: And-Adʿarez son-of Kirem, servant-of Sergu (?);
sentences.i: And Adʿarez son of Kirem, servant of Sergu (?);
sentences.n: ደቀ is the construct of ደቅ 'servant, youth, disciple'; ደቅ is also the singular of ደቂቅ 'sons' (unit 0), so 'child-of' is as possible as 'servant-of' (?). ሰርጒ is unclear: a place or personal name, or a word for a feast (?). I do not translate beyond that.

sentences.t: ወደለክም ፡ ወልደ ፡ ማትሬም ፡ ሊቀ ፡ ሐራ ፡ ለአፍራስ ፤
sentences.l: And-Delekem son-of Matrem, chief-of soldiers for-horses;
sentences.i: And Delekem son of Matrem, chief of the soldiers of the horses;
sentences.n: ሊቀ ሐራ ለአፍራስ 'chief-of soldiers, of horses' (አፍራስ the plural of ፈረስ 'horse'), that is, commander of the cavalry. The ለ- here marks the possessor.

sentences.t: ወአደርዮስ ፡ ወልደ ፡ ኔድሮስ ፡ ሊቀ ፡ ሐራ ፡ ለአጋር ፤
sentences.l: And-Aderyos son-of Nedros, chief-of soldiers for-Agar (?);
sentences.i: And Aderyos son of Nedros, chief of the soldiers of Agar (?);
sentences.n: The same pattern. አጋር is uncertain (?): it may be Hagar or the Hagarenes (Arabs) as a people or place, or another word entirely. Left as Agar.

sentences.t: ወአውስጥራን ፡ ወልደ ፡ ዮዳድ ፡ ጸዋሬ ፡ ክብር ፤
sentences.l: And-Awstran son-of Yodad, bearer-of glory;
sentences.i: And Awstran son of Yodad, bearer of glory;
sentences.n: ጸዋሬ is the construct of ጸዋሪ 'bearer, carrier' (from ጸውረ 'carry'); ክብር 'glory, honour'. Perhaps the bearer of the royal regalia or honours (?).

sentences.t: ወአስተርአዮን ፡ ወልደ ፡ አሳ ፡ ቃለ ፡ ታዕካ ፤
sentences.l: And-Asteraeyon son-of Asa, voice-of taʿka (?);
sentences.i: And Asteraeyon son of Asa, voice of the taʿka (?);
sentences.n: ቃለ is the construct of ቃል 'word, voice', so 'voice-of'; ታዕካ is a word I am unsure of (?): it looks like a court or audience-place, and it recurs two units below. So this may be a herald or spokesman of the court (?).

sentences.t: ወኢሚ ፡ ወልደ ፡ መታትያስ ፡ ሊቀ ፡ መጽብእት ፤
sentences.l: And-Imi son-of Matatyas, chief-of battles;
sentences.i: And Imi son of Matatyas, chief of battles;
sentences.n: መጽብእት is 'battle, war', from ጸብአ 'fight'; ሊቀ መጽብእት 'chief-of battles' is a war-leader.

sentences.t: ወማክሪ ፡ ወልደ ፡ አቢሳ ፡ ፈታሔ ፡ ታዕካ ፤
sentences.l: And-Makri son-of Abisa, judge-of taʿka (?);
sentences.i: And Makri son of Abisa, judge of the taʿka (?);
sentences.n: ፈታሔ is the construct of ፈታሒ 'judge'. The word ታዕካ again (?).

sentences.t: ወአቢስ ፡ ወልደ ፡ ካርዮስ ፡ መአስሪ ፤
sentences.l: And-Abis son-of Karyos, tithe-taker (?);
sentences.i: And Abis son of Karyos, tithe-taker (?);
sentences.n: መአስሪ may come from ዐሠረ 'take a tenth' or from ዐሥር 'ten', so 'collector of tithes' or a captain of tens (?). The spelling with አ rather than ዐ, and ስ rather than ሠ, makes it less sure.

sentences.t: ሊቀ ፡ ውንድዮስ ፡ ወልደ ፡ ኔልንት ፡ ዮስ ፡ መስፍነ ፡ ዐውድ ፤
sentences.l: Chief-of Wundeyos son-of Nelnt Yos, ruler-of circuit;
sentences.i: Chief Wundeyos son of Nelnt Yos, ruler of the district;
sentences.n: ሊቀ here stands before the name instead of before the office, and ኔልንት ዮስ is written as two words; both look like oddities of the source, kept as they are. መስፍን 'ruler, prince' (construct መስፍነ) and ዐውድ 'circuit, round, district' (?), so a governor of a region.

sentences.t: ወካርሚ ፡ ወልደ ፡ ሐፃንያስ ፡ ሊቀ ፡ ገባር ፡ ዘቤተ ፡ ንጉሥ ፤
sentences.l: And-Karmi son-of Hatsanyas, chief-of workers of-house-of king;
sentences.i: And Karmi son of Hatsanyas, chief of the workers of the king's house;
sentences.n: ገባር is 'worker, labourer' (or 'tributary'). ዘቤተ ንጉሥ is ዘ- 'of, that of' + ቤተ, the construct of ቤት 'house', + ንጉሥ: 'of the house of the king', so the royal household.

sentences.t: ወስራንያስ ፡ ወልደ ፡ አካዝኤል ፡ መጋቢ ፡ ዘቤተ ፡ ንጉሥ ፤
sentences.l: And-Sranyas son-of Akazel, steward of-house-of king;
sentences.i: And Sranyas son of Akazel, steward of the king's house;
sentences.n: መጋቢ is 'steward, one who provides' (?), probably from a root for providing or serving (?); the title fits a household manager. Same ዘቤተ ንጉሥ as before.

sentences.t: እሉ ፡ ኵሎሙ ፡ እለ ፡ ተውህቡ ፡ ለዳዊት ፡ ንጉሠ ፡ ኢትዮጵያ ፡ ወልደ ፡ ሰሎሞን ፡ ንጉሠ ፡ እስራኤል ፨
sentences.l: These all who were-given to-David king-of Ethiopia son-of Solomon king-of Israel;
sentences.i: These are all who were given to David, king of Ethiopia, the son of Solomon, king of Israel;
sentences.n: እሉ ኵሎሙ is 'these, all of them', a summary. ተውህቡ is the 3mp passive of ወሀበ 'give' (ተውህበ will recur). The two titles show the new realm as a double of the old: David king of Ethiopia, son of Solomon king of Israel. The ፨ ends the list.

sentences.t: ወዓዲ ፡ ወሀቦ ፡ አፍራሰ ፡ ወሰረገላተ ፡ ራኵባተ ፡ ወአብቅልተ ፡ ወጽዑነ ፡ ሰረገላተወርቀ ፡ ወብሩረ ፡ ወአልባሰ ፡ ክቡረ ፡ ቢሶሰ ፡ ወሜላተ ፡ ዕንቈ ፡ ባሕርያተ ፡ ወአፍራጸ ፡ ወኵሎ ፡ ዘይትፈቀድ ፡ ለብሔረ ፡ ኢትዮጵያ ፡ ወሀቦ ፡ ለወልዱ ፨
sentences.l: And-also he-gave-him horses, and-chariots riding (?), and-mules, and-laden (?) chariots-(and)-gold (?), and-silver, and-garments precious, byssus, and-dyed-stuff (?) stone-of pearls (?), and-ʾäfraṣä (?), and-all that is-needed for-land-of Ethiopia, and-he-gave-him, to-his-son;
sentences.i: And he also gave him horses, riding chariots (?), mules, laden (?) chariots, gold, silver, precious garments, fine linen, a dyed stuff (?), pearls (?), [ʾäfraṣä] (?), and everything that is needed for the land of Ethiopia; he gave all this to his son;
sentences.n: ወዓዲ 'and also'. ወሀቦ is the 3ms perfect with -ኦ 'him' (Solomon gives; the same suffix comes back before ለወልዱ at the end, the anticipating pattern again). The objects have the accusative ending -ä (first order): አፍራሰ 'horses', ሰረገላተ 'chariots', አብቅልተ 'mules'. ራኵባተ is 'riding, mounted', as I read it (?); ጽዑነ is 'laden', a singular form beside plural ሰረገላተ, so the agreement is not clean (?). The source runs ሰረገላተወርቀ together; every other item has its own ወ-, so I take it as ሰረገላተ + ወ- + ወርቀ with the doubled ወ written once, 'chariots, and gold' (?); 'chariots of gold' is the other reading. ቢሶሰ is Greek byssos 'fine linen'. ሜላተ is a dyed stuff, perhaps purple, unidentified (?), as in ch. 31–32. ዕንቈ ባሕርያተ is 'stone of pearls', that is pearls; ባሕርይ also means 'nature', so 'pearls' is a sense-by-context reading (?), as in ch. 30. አፍራጸ is not understood (?); as in ch. 29 it is left in transliteration rather than guessed. ዘይትፈቀድ 'what is wished for, needed' (passive of ፈቀደ). The gifts are those Solomon gave to his son.

sentences.t: ወእምዝ ፡ ተደለዉ ፡ ከመ ፡ ይሖሩ ፤
sentences.l: And-then they-were-ready that they-go;
sentences.i: And then they made ready to go;
sentences.n: ተደለዉ is the 3mp perfect of ተደለወ 'be ready, prepared'; ይሖሩ the 3mp subjunctive of ሖረ 'go'.

sentences.t: ወኮነ ፡ ፍሥሓ ፡ ለመኳንንተ ፡ ንጉሠ ፡ ኢትዮጵያ ።
sentences.l: And-there-was joy for-nobles-of king-of Ethiopia.
sentences.i: And there was joy among the nobles of the king of Ethiopia.
sentences.n: ወኮነ 'and there was'; ፍሥሓ 'joy' as subject. መኳንንተ is the construct (accusative-form) of መኳንንት, and ንጉሠ ኢትዮጵያ a second construct, 'nobles-of king-of Ethiopia'. ኮነ + ለ- is the usual way to say 'there was to them'.

sentences.t: ወኮነ ፡ ሐዘነ ፡ ለመኳንንተ ፡ ንጉሠ ፡ እስራኤል ፤
sentences.l: And-there-was grief for-nobles-of king-of Israel;
sentences.i: And there was grief among the nobles of the king of Israel;
sentences.n: A deliberate parallel to the unit before: ሐዘነ is the accusative of ሐዘን, 'grief', after ኮነ. Joy for one side, grief for the other.

sentences.t: እስመ ፡ በእንተ ፡ በኵሩ ፡ ለሰሎሞን ፡ ንጉሠ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ዝውእቱ ፡ ንጉሠ ፡ ኢትዮጵያ ፡ ተውህበ ፡ በኵሮሙ ፡ ለመኳንንተ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ከመ ፡ ይንግሡ ፡ ለብሔረ ፡ ኢትዮጵያ ፡ ምስለ ፡ ወልደ ፡ ሰሎሞን ፡ ንጉሥ ።
sentences.l: for on-account-of firstborn-his of-Solomon king-of Israel, this-is king-of Ethiopia, was-given their-firstborn for-nobles-of Israel, that they-reign for-land-of Ethiopia with son-of Solomon king.
sentences.i: for, on account of his firstborn, Solomon's, the king of Israel's, he who is king of Ethiopia, the firstborn of the nobles of Israel were given, that they might reign over the land of Ethiopia with the son of King Solomon.
sentences.n: በኵሩ ለሰሎሞን 'his firstborn, Solomon's' is the same ለ- possessor pattern with an anticipatory suffix. ዝውእቱ ንጉሠ ኢትዮጵያ glosses him: 'that is, the king of Ethiopia'. ተውህበ is 3ms, with the collective በኵሮሙ 'their firstborn' as subject. ከመ ይንግሡ is the 3mp subjunctive of ነግሠ; ነግሠ takes ለ- for the realm, 'reign over'. The sons are to rule Ethiopia with Menelik, the nobles of Israel being in effect the ruling class of the new Israel.

sentences.t: ወእምዝ ፡ ተጋብኡ ፡ ወበከዩ ፡ ምስለ ፡ አበዊሆሙ ፡ ወእማቲሆሙ ፡ ወአዝማዲሆሙ ፡ ወአንጋዲሆሙ ፡ ምስለ ፡ ሕዘቢሆሙ ፡ ወበሓውርቲሆሙ ፡ ወይረግምዎ ፡ በኅቡእ ፡ ለንጉሥ ፡ ወየሐምይዎ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ዘሄደ ፡ ደቂቆሙ ፡ ዘእ ፡ ንበለ ፡ ፈቃዶሙ ፤
sentences.l: And-then they-gathered and-wept with their-fathers and-their-mothers and-their-kinsmen and-their-? with their-people and-among-their-? and-they-curse-him in-secret, the-king, and-they-blame-him because that-went their-sons without their-will;
sentences.i: And then they gathered and wept with their fathers, their mothers, their kinsmen and their ... (?), with their people and among their ... (?), and they curse him in secret, the king, and blame him because their sons went without their consent;
sentences.n: ተጋብኡ 'they gathered' and በከዩ 'they wept' are 3mp perfects. ምስለ 'with'; እማቲሆሙ 'their mothers' (እም), አዝማዲሆሙ 'their kinsmen' (አዝማድ). አንጋዲሆሙ and በሓውርቲሆሙ are words I cannot confirm (?); the second might be related to ሓወረ 'go', but I do not translate them. ሕዘቢሆሙ may be 'their peoples, their kindred'. ይረግምዎ is 3mp imperfect of ረገመ 'curse' + -ዎ 'him', and የሐምይዎ is, I take it, from ሐመየ 'blame, slander' (?). ዘሄደ is ዘ- 'that' + ሄደ 'went' (collective subject); ሄደ is not the usual ሖረ, and I cannot check it (?). ዘእ ንበለ is the preposition ዘእንበለ 'without' split by the source into two words.

sentences.t: ወለንጉሥሰ ፡ ይብልዎ ፡ ሠናየ ፡ ገበርከ ፡ በእንተዝ ፡ እስመ ፡ ኀየሰ ፡ ጥበብከ ፡ ከመ ፡ መንግሥተ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ኮነት ፡ ለብሔረ ፡ ኢትዮጵያ ፡ በፈቃደ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ወበጥበበ ፡ ዚአከ ፡ ወካልኣንኒ ፡ መንግሥታት ፡ ያገብኦን ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ውስተ ፡ እዴከ ፡ እስመ ፡ ሠናየ ፡ ትኄሊ ፡ ለእግዚኣብሔር ፡ ወትፈቅድ ፡ ከመ ፡ ያምልክዎ ፡ ለአምላከ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ወከመ ፡ ይሠረዉ ፡ ጣዖታት ፡ እምዓለም ።
sentences.l: And-to-the-king-indeed they-say-to-him: 'Well you-have-done on-this-account, for good your-wisdom, that kingdom-of Israel has-become for-land-of Ethiopia by-will-of God and-by-wisdom yours; and-other-also kingdoms God hands-over-them into your-hand, for good you-think for-God and-you-wish that they-worship-him, the-God-of Israel, and-that be-rooted-out idols (?) from-the-world.'
sentences.i: But to the king they say: 'You have done well in this, for your wisdom is good, in that the kingdom of Israel has come to the land of Ethiopia by the will of God and by your wisdom. And God will also hand over other kingdoms into your hand, for you think what is good toward God and you wish that they worship the God of Israel, and that the idols be rooted out of the world.'
sentences.n: ወለንጉሥሰ 'but to the king indeed' (-ሰ contrasts with their cursing in secret; they speak to his face). ይብልዎ 'they say to him'. ሠናየ ገበርከ is 'well (acc. adverb) you did' (2ms perfect). በእንተዝ 'on account of this'. ኀየሰ is the 3ms perfect of ኀየሰ 'be good, excellent' (?). መንግሥተ is the construct of መንግሥት 'kingdom', here the Israelite kingdom 'come to' Ethiopia: the translatio, the transfer of the kingdom from Israel to Ethiopia. ዚአከ 'yours' (the independent possessive; ጥበበ ዚአከ 'wisdom, yours'). ካልኣንኒ is 'others also' (ካልእ + -ኒ). ያገብኦን is አግብአ 'hand over, bring back' (as in ch. 33–34 and 41), 3ms + -ን '3fp them' (kingdoms are feminine). ትኄሊ is 2ms imperfect of ኀለየ 'think'. ያምልክዎ is አምለከ 'worship' + -ዎ 'him'. ይሠረዉ is 3mp of ሠረወ 'uproot'; ጣዖታት has no accusative ending, so I read it as the subject, 'that the idols be rooted out' (?); the active 'that they root out the idols' is the other reading. ጣዖታት 'idols'. These words are a flattering speech, because the nobles are afraid; the next unit shows that.

sentences.t: ወይዌድስዎ ፡ ወይብልዎ ፡ ይእዜ ፡ አእመርነ ፡ ከመ ፡ በእንቲአከ ፡ ይቤሎ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ለአቡነ ፡ አብርሃም ፡ በዘርእከ ፡ ይትባረኩ ፡ ኵሎሙ ፡ አሕዛበ ፡ ምድር ፤
sentences.l: And-they-praise-him and-they-say: 'Now we-know that concerning-you said-to-him God to-our-father Abraham: In-your-seed will-be-blessed all nations-of earth;'
sentences.i: And they praise him and say: 'Now we know that it was concerning you that God said to our father Abraham: In your seed all the nations of the earth will be blessed;'
sentences.n: ይዌድስዎ is the 3mp imperfect of ወደሰ 'praise' + -ዎ 'him'. ይእዜ 'now'; አእመርነ 'we know' (1cp perfect of አእመረ). በእንቲአከ 'concerning you' (በእንተ + -ከ). ይቤሎ 'said to him' (ይቤ + -ሎ), here 'God said to Abraham'. The quotation is Genesis 22:18 (also 12:3, 26:4): 'in your seed all the nations of the earth shall be blessed'. ይትባረኩ is the 3mp passive imperfect; አሕዛበ the construct of አሕዛብ 'nations', before ምድር 'earth'. The nobles apply the blessing of Abraham's seed to Solomon's son in Ethiopia.

sentences.t: ወያሤንዩ ፡ ገጾሙ ፡ ወይስሕቁ ፡ በቅድሜሁ ፡ ወይዌድስዎ ፡ ፈድፋደ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ጥበቡ ፤
sentences.l: And-they-make-pleasant their-faces and-they-laugh before-him and-they-praise-him exceedingly on-account-of his-wisdom;
sentences.i: They put on pleasant faces and laugh before him, and praise him exceedingly for his wisdom;
sentences.n: ያሤንዩ is the 3mp imperfect of the causative (አሠነየ) of ሠነየ 'be good', so 'they make good, beautiful': 'they put on fair looks', as I read it (?). ይስሕቁ 'they laugh' (ሰሐቀ). በቅድሜሁ 'before him' (ቅድሜ + -ሁ). ፈድፋደ 'exceedingly' (adverb). The flattery is feigned, which the narrator says plainly.

sentences.t: ወሶበ ፡ ዘንተ ፡ ይብልዎያአምሮሙ ፡ በጥበብ ፡ ወይትዔገሶሙ ፤
sentences.l: And-when this they-say-to-him-he-knows-them with-wisdom and-he-bears-with-them;
sentences.i: And when they say this to him, he knows them through wisdom and bears with them;
sentences.n: The source writes ይብልዎያአምሮሙ as one word: ይብልዎ 'they say to him' + ያአምሮሙ 'he knows them' (3ms imperfect of አእመረ + -ሙ). ሶበ 'when'. ይትዔገሶሙ is the 3ms imperfect of ተዔገሰ 'be patient with, endure' + -ሙ 'them'. The king sees through them and shows patience.

sentences.t: እስመ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ይትዔገሰነ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ያአምር ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ኀጢአተነ ፤
sentences.l: for God is-patient-with-us while he-knows all our-sin;
sentences.i: for God is patient with us, though he knows all our sin;
sentences.n: ይትዔገሰነ is the same verb as in the unit before, with -ነ 'us'. እንዘ ያአምር is 'while he knows' (እንዘ + the 3ms imperfect). ኀጢአተነ is ኀጢአት 'sin' (accusative) + -ነ 'our'. Menelik's patience is held up as an imitation of divine patience.

sentences.t: መንግሥትሰ ፡ ለእግዚኣብሔር ፡ ኵላ ፡ ምድር ፡ ወሰማያትኒ ፡ ወአጽናፈ ፡ ዓለም ፡ ወባሕር ፡ ወየብስ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ይኴንን ፤
sentences.l: Kingdom-indeed of-God; whole earth and-heavens-also and-ends-of world and-sea and-dry-land he rules;
sentences.i: The kingdom, indeed, is God's: the whole earth, and the heavens too, and the ends of the world, and the sea and the dry land he himself rules;
sentences.n: መንግሥትሰ ለእግዚኣብሔር 'the kingdom indeed (belongs) to God', the ለ- of possession. Then a list that is the object of ይኴንን (ኵላ and አጽናፈ carry the accusative ending): ኵላ ምድር 'the whole earth', ሰማያትኒ 'the heavens also', አጽናፈ ዓለም 'the ends-of world', ባሕር 'sea', የብስ 'dry land'. ውእቱ ይኴንን is 'he himself rules/judges' (ኰነነ), with the pronoun ውእቱ emphasising the subject. This is the doctrine that human kings rule by delegation.

sentences.t: ወለንጉሠ ፡ ምድርሂ ፡ ወሀቦ ፡ እምታሕቴሁ ፡ ከመ ፡ ይኴንን ፡ ከማሁ ፡ ለእለ ፡ ይገብርዋ ፡ ለእኪት ፡ ከመ ፡ ይፍድዮሙ ፡ እኩየ ፡ ወለእለ ፡ ይገብርዋ ፡ ለሠናይት ፡ ከመ ፡ ይዕስዮሙ ፡ ሠና ፡ የ ፤
sentences.l: And-to-king-of earth-also he-gave from-beneath-himself that he-judge; likewise to-those who do it, the-evil, that he-repay-them evil, and-to-those who do it, the-good, that he-reward-them good;
sentences.i: And to the king of the earth also he has given it, from beneath himself, that he may judge; likewise, as to those who do evil, that he repay them evil, and as to those who do good, that he reward them good;
sentences.n: ለንጉሠ ምድርሂ 'and to the king of the earth too' (-ሂ 'also'). ወሀቦ is 'gave him / it'. እምታሕቴሁ is 'from beneath him', that is, the king rules as God's subordinate. ከማሁ here is a connective 'likewise'. ይገብርዋ ለእኪት: the verb carries -ዋ '3fs it' which resumes ለእኪት 'the evil (thing)', the same anticipating pattern. ይፍድዮሙ is the 3ms subjunctive of ፈደየ 'repay' + -ሙ; ይዕስዮሙ that of ዐሰየ 'reward' + -ሙ. The source splits ሠናየ into ሠና የ, a spacing oddity; the sense is 'good'.

sentences.t: እስመ ፡ መንፈሰ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ያዐርፍ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ልቡ ፡ ለንጉሥ ፡ ወእደዊሁ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ኅሊናሁ ፡ ወአእምሮቱ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ልቡናሁ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨
sentences.l: for spirit-of God rests in his-heart, of-the-king, and-his-hands in his-thought, and-his-knowledge in his-understanding.
sentences.i: for the spirit of God rests in the king's heart, and his hands in his thought, and his knowledge in his understanding.
sentences.n: መንፈሰ is the construct of መንፈስ 'spirit', 'spirit-of God'. ያዐርፍ 'rests' (3ms imperfect of the A stem አዕረፈ, used intransitively as in ch. 42); the next two clauses have no verb and 'rests' is carried over to them. ልቡ ለንጉሥ is the anticipatory suffix with ለ- again: 'his heart, of the king'. The rest is a parallel list of three, ኅሊና 'thought' and ልቡና 'understanding'. The wording recalls Isaiah 11:2 (the spirit of the Lord resting on the king) and Proverbs 21:1 (the king's heart in the Lord's hand) (?). The source ends the unit and the part with a run of eight ፨, kept attached exactly as written (the previous part also ends with eight).
